summary.en: Never sell or give your account, passbook or cash card to anyone. It is a crime. Accounts in the names of foreign residents sold to criminal groups when they return home have been misused as destinations for special fraud (Japanese Bankers Association). A 2026 amendment to the Act on Prevention of Transfer of Criminal Proceeds raises penalties for the unlawful transfer of deposit passbooks and similar acts, effective 10 July 2026. Check the National Police Agency page for the details of the penalties (to be checked). The Financial Services Agency publishes a leaflet explaining, among other things, that accounts held by foreign residents require notifying the financial institution that the period of stay has been renewed or that a renewal is pending (check the source for details; to be checked). Close accounts you no longer use at a bank counter instead of selling them (examples: MUFG Bank and Japan Post Bank). Conditions differ by bank. Check with your own bank (to be checked).

text.en: Close accounts you no longer use at a bank counter (do not sell or hand them over)

evidence.quote: 外国籍の方が在留期間の満了などの理由で帰国し、預貯金口座を利用しなくなるときは、金融機関の窓口に行き、預貯金口座を解約するようご案内ください。

text.en: When you return home and no longer use an account, close it at a financial institution counter. Check with your own bank (to be checked).

evidence.quote: 外国人名義の預貯金口座について、在留期間を更新済み又は申請中である旨を金融機関に届け出る必要性等をまとめたリーフレットを作成（７言語対応）しましたので、以下よりご参照ください。（令和７年４月公表）
第三者に利用させることを目的とした口座(通帳・キャッシュカード)の譲渡や売買は犯罪です。絶対に行わないでください。
